default_pose.name: photo_raised
default_pose.choice: Moderate raised attitude matching the photographed Z silhouette; selected for part recognition.
default_pose.no_physics_claim: The two slender rods and small barrel are individually placed from visible geometry. Their centre positions are not a solved closed-loop mechanism.

optional_folded_display.meaning: Alternate static zero-angle display parameters; provided only for silhouette comparisons with CAD/photo19.
optional_folded_display.limitations: Not an animation, not a trajectory, not a verified stowed lock or collision-free mechanical state. Do not interpolate poses as physical motion.

included: Two narrow adjustable rods with locknuts and eyes
Twin collector strips and downturned horns
excluded: Force law or air-bellows effective area
Mechanism closure and real travel stops

unresolved_before_physics: Actual joint topology and axial directions
Air-bellows versus B32 cylinder registration and force path
Full lower/upper arm dimensions and cross sections
Head vertical compliance and carbon geometry/material calibration
Operating range and stow/latch collision clearances
runtime_source_dependencies: None. Geometry is parameterized from the evidence ledger; no absolute cloud path, external mesh, camera, export, or runtime source download is used.
